name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. Accurately describes the function: it opens the battle tactical-overview screen, a smooth zoom-out battlefield preview. No Ghidra address residue in the name. 'open' matches the lifecycle (it runs the whole open/loop/close sequence and returns to the caller).
purpose: Open and run the battle tactical-overview (zoom-out battlefield map preview): a smooth-scaling map centered on the cursor showing every live unit as a 1-byte team-tinted square plus a separate animated cursor square, until the player presses a key.
logic_summary: Setup: __CHK(0x60) stack probe; save data_fd2_battle_scene_snapshot then rebuild the tile cache at 24px via fd2_convert_battle_tiles_to_24px (stored back into the snapshot global for scaled rendering); copy the 3-entry team-color base table; pick zoom_level (4 for short maps <=0x28 tall, else 3) and scroll_origin (0x280 / 0x380); compute the 16:6 fixed-point camera base (origin*0xC00 + max*0x600) and max (dim*0x600) for x and y; malloc 0x4000 per-tile sprite-pointer table and fill it (stride 0x40 rows) with pointers into the 24px cache (snapshot + tile_attr*0x240 + 6). Intro: 7-frame zoom-in (frame 1..7), camera interpolated by ratio (frame+1)/8 with signed truncating div-by-8, scale = scroll_origin*frame/7 + 0x80; each frame fd2_blit_scaled_tile_map_view renders to the large game-state buffer then memmove to VGA 0xA0000 (64000 bytes); clear keyboard. Display loop: until a key is buffered, repaint every >=2 BIOS ticks (BIOS_TICK_WORD @ 0x46C, signed; first iteration repaints because last_tick is seeded with garbage). Per repaint: compute half-extents for centering; for each party member skip dead (flags&1) / portrait 0x79 / archetype 0x0A, else draw a zoom_level x zoom_level square at the unit's scaled map pos tinted team_color[team]+anim_phase; draw the cursor square tinted anim_phase+0x18; bounce anim_phase in 0..7 via anim_dir; latch last_tick. Exit: set key_input_mode=0x10 and consume the scancode via int386(0x16); 6-frame zoom-out (frame 6..1, reverse interpolation, same camera math, ratio frame+1); free the tile table and the 24px cache; restore the saved data_fd2_battle_scene_snapshot; fd2_composite_battle_frame(0) to repaint the battle screen.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effects only: renders the tactical-overview animation to the VGA framebuffer, blocks until a keypress, then restores and recomposites the battle screen.
